Method of Attack: Execution of obfuscated VB script to fetch and execute malware loader
Loading two variants of PeepingTitle backdoor for screen capture and user interaction monitoring
Logging user input including credentials when financial institution windows are detected
Capturing screenshots, terminating processes, changing monitoring intervals, staging payloads from executables or DLLs
Fetching additional payloads after registering victim machine and sending reconnaissance details
Impacted Systems: Systems of Portuguese government and private financial institutions including ActivoBank, Caixa Geral de Depósitos, CaixaBank, Citibanamex, Santander, Millennium BCP, ING, Banco BPI, Novobanco
Attack Vector: Phishing emails impersonating Energias de Portugal (EDP) and Portuguese Tax and Customs Authority (AT)
